intent: Second-stage composition: Derive deterministic context-separated key material with HKDF
limitations: Inputs satisfy the composition schema. No unsupported composition inputs are scored.
instructions: Implement transform(input:string,lib)->string. Parse {version:1,hash,ikm,salt,labels:[string,...],message:hex}; valid first-stage hash/key/salt values, 1..5 labels (duplicates and empty labels permitted), valid even-length message hex. For each label in order form UTF8("AEGIS5:"+label) as info, derive 32 bytes with retained lib["a5-02"] called on the JSON first-stage request, and compute HMAC-SHA256(messageBytes) under that derived key. Return ordered [{label,tag:lowercaseHex},...]. Use the exact Unicode text without normalization. Full composition-reuse credit requires at least one actual retained call per label. HMAC via node:crypto is available. targetSample is a JSON output example. Classification: (b) a second-stage behavioral goal; the first-stage contract and software versions remain unchanged. This is not dependency revalidation.
